page: Microsoft Azure L4as_v5 is an x86_64 virtual machine within the Lasv5 server family, utilizing a dedicated AMD processor. This instance is configured with 4 virtual CPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed through the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

The instance includes 960 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance storage configurations. It does not contain integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local storage, the L4as_v5 is designed for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. It is suitable for database hosting, caching layers, and data processing tasks where local read/write speeds and memory capacity are critical. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention.
